definitions.gloss: riverbed; dry stony area beside a river
definitions.explanation: The flat, often rocky or sandy area along a river that is dry except during high water. A popular spot for picnics, fireworks, and camping in Japan.

examples.japanese: {河原|かわら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I played down by the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{河原|かわら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦バーベキュー→バーベキュー：27519_baabekyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In summer we do barbecues on the riverbed.

examples.japanese: {河原|かわら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ごろごろ→ごろごろ：05176_gorogoro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{転|ころ}がっていた→転がる：02571_korogaru⟧。
examples.english: Big rocks were scattered all over the riverbed.

notes:
Written {河原|かわら} or {川原|かわら}; both readings are かわら and refer to the same thing. Distinct from the homophone ⟦{瓦|かわら}→瓦：03902_kawara⟧ (roof tile).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {河原|かわら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧: stones on the riverbed
- {河原|かわら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play by the river
- {河原|かわら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set off fireworks at the riverbed
- {河原|かわら}{沿|ぞ}い: along the riverbed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{川岸|かわぎし}→川岸：24545_kawagishi⟧: riverbank — the edge/border of the river, not the dry stony zone
- ⟦{河川敷|かせんしき}→河川敷：24122_kasenshiki⟧: river floodplain — formal/administrative term for the same area
